A_hard_runtime_fact_binding.mechanism: HardRuntimeFactBinding requires canonical Book 2 claims whose proposition qualifier equals the D4-6 fact class; a generic claim cannot support a specific fact

B_failure_domain_mechanism.mechanism: mechanism_claim_refs must resolve as canonical FAILURE_MECHANISM claims; raw evidence refs are lineage only
B_failure_domain_mechanism.independence: positive_independence_claim_refs must resolve as canonical POSITIVE_INDEPENDENCE claims

C_redundancy_referential_integrity.mechanism: RedundancyBook requires a FailureDomainBook and resolves every failure_domain_ref; independence assertions resolve through Book 2 provenance

D_snapshot_lineage.mechanism: Book4Provenance.validate_snapshot_lineage requires each source_snapshot_ref to originate from the resolved Book 2 claim evidence raw_snapshot_ref; no second snapshot registry
D_snapshot_lineage.known_limitation: Book 2 exposes snapshot identity only through RawEvidence.raw_snapshot_ref, so lineage equality is the narrowest available check

E_book5_boundary.mechanism: book4_boundary.Book4RelationSupportPolicy is the structural authority; keyword screening is defense in depth
